audit.whatIsWrong: Content and full read Graves/Skill/Yone/Yone/Graves/Yone/Yone; the packet chart reads Skill/Graves/Graves/Graves/Graves/Graves/Yone. The prose agrees with the packet on all seven — whys[0] 'lane opens near-even', whys[3] 'you out-tank and out-burst him in every extended brawl', mid opens 'This is your window'. The lane is also labelled TRICKY at 7/10 difficulty on a 56% win rate.
audit.why: A 56% lane presented as tricky, with the levels 2 through first-item stretch — the entire stretch the text says Graves owns — handed to Yone on the chart.
audit.corrected: All seven rows set to the packet chart with ratings 5/7/7/7/7/7/3; diff to EVEN, diffRating to 5/10, and both difficulty lines rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown anywhere on a page whose whole win condition is 'commit on Soul Unbound's cooldown' — the packet counts 1 sequencing cue.
audit.why: Soul Unbound is 22/19/16/13/10s and Fate Sealed is 120/100/80s. At rank 1 that is a 22-second punish window after every spirit commit and a two-minute gap between his ults; by rank 5 the E window is down to 10 and the plan changes.
audit.corrected: Soul Unbound's 22s and Fate Sealed's 120s now appear in spikes[2], early and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: (a) Fate Sealed is called a 'double-knockup' and an 'R knockup' in spikes[3], late and wants.foe[2]. Riot's text is a blink behind the last champion in a line with a slash that PULLS all enemies hit toward him — the kit's knockup flag sits on Mortal Steel, not on R. (b) 'Smoke Screen blinds his autos' six times — W reduces sight range and slows on impact. (c) 'second E charge' twice — Quickdraw is one dash on 16/15/14/13/12s refreshed by landing autos. (d) 'your R doubles as a wall-escape' twice — Collateral Damage has no displacement in its text. (e) The packet's own defect note: none of Yone's ability names appear in the content layer at all.
audit.why: Pull versus knockup changes where you stand. A player expecting to be thrown expects to land away from him; Fate Sealed drags you toward him, which is the opposite positioning read and the reason the follow-up kills you.
audit.corrected: R described as a blink-behind and pull, W as sight denial plus slow, E as one refreshing dash, and Mortal Steel, Spirit Cleave, Soul Unbound and Fate Sealed now named in content.

audit.why: Wave advice is specific and matches the matchup — hold near the middle, never crash with E down.

edits.before: Level 1-2 is close to even — Yone's Q is a fast poke with short cooldowns and his W gives him a shield in melee, so don't force your point-blank shells into a fight he can answer; just last-hit and keep your magazine loaded. The lane tilts your way at 3: dash in with E for the bonus armor, drop Smoke Screen on him so his autos and his empowered third-Q whiff blind, and detonate End of the Line on top of him before his W shield eats it. His sustain trade can't beat your shell burst plus stacking True Grit while he's blinded — but his E lets his spirit detach and snap back to his body, so don't over-commit chasing one E.
edits.after: Level 1-2 is close to even — Mortal Steel is a fast poke on 4 seconds and Spirit Cleave shields him in melee, so don't force your point-blank shells into a fight he can answer; just last-hit and keep your magazine loaded. The lane tilts your way at 3: dash in with E for the bonus armor, drop Smoke Screen on him so he loses sight of you inside the cloud, and detonate End of the Line on top of him before Spirit Cleave shields it. His sustain can't beat your shell burst plus stacking True Grit — but Soul Unbound detaches his spirit and snaps it back on 22s, so don't over-commit chasing one E.

edits.before: This is your window. Through 4-5 your True Grit armor/MR and second E charge compound, so every extended brawl goes your way — dash E in, Smoke Screen to blind his autos, Q-burst, and his W shield and Q sustain can't keep up. At 6 Collateral Damage is the kill: when he detaches his spirit with E, fire R into him so he takes the nuke before he can snap back, and remember your R doubles as a wall-escape if he tries to flip you with his own R knockup. Eclipse or Youmuu's is your peak duel — force the all-in here, because once he buys Infinity Edge and crits his auto-attack DPS climbs fast.
edits.after: This is your window. Through 4-5 your True Grit armor/MR and a Quickdraw your autos keep refreshing compound, so every extended brawl goes your way — dash E in, Smoke Screen to blank his sight, Q-burst, and Spirit Cleave's shield can't keep up. At 6 Collateral Damage is the kill: when Soul Unbound detaches his spirit, fire R into him so he takes the nuke before he snaps back. Respect Fate Sealed — it blinks him behind you and pulls you in, on 120s at rank 1. Eclipse or Youmuu's is your peak duel: force the all-in before Infinity Edge lands.

edits.before: You fall off the moment his crit items come online. A two-item Yone with IE and crit shreds with autos and his empowered Q3, kites your reload windows by dashing in and out with E, and uses the spirit detach plus his R double-knockup to disengage and re-engage — your armor stacking does little against a fed mobile carry who never has to stand still in your point-blank range. Win the lane outright in the first 15 minutes and convert the lead into objectives, because if the game goes long he out-scales you and becomes a side-lane and teamfight problem you can't pin down.
edits.after: You fall off the moment his crit items come online. A two-item Yone with IE and crit shreds with autos and his empowered Q3, kites your reload windows by dashing in and out with Soul Unbound, and uses the spirit detach plus the Fate Sealed pull to disengage and re-engage — your armor stacking does little against a fed mobile carry who never has to stand still in your point-blank range. Win the lane outright in the first 15 minutes and convert the lead into objectives, because if the game goes long he becomes a side-lane and teamfight problem you can't pin down.

notes: Fate Sealed was described as a knockup in three places; Riot's text is a blink behind the target line plus a pull toward him, and the kit's knockup flag is on Mortal Steel. That is a positioning error, not a wording one. Also fixed the difficulty label: TRICKY at 7/10 on a 56% win rate contradicted the packet and the page's own 'This is your window' prose. The packet's defect note about Yone's abilities never being named is addressed in the content layer.
